summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on adjusting data for Estonia, specifically concerning a factor calculation that was found to be incorrect. It was determined that recalculating the historical data based solely on the factor (without involving full models or ML) would be the simplest approach.

Separately, project priorities were reviewed and established: 1) Real-time dashboard development; 2) Impression model creation; and 3) Integration of 2D lidar data for Estonia. The priority order was confirmed to place the impression model before the 2D lidar data.
decisions: Historical data for Estonia will be recalculated based only on the factor, without using complex models or ML components.
action_items: [me] will perform the recalculation of historical data for Estonia.
